job.title: Home Chef
job.description:
We are hiring a Home Chef for a household in Wuye and Wuse 2, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role with accommodation and weekly days off.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and cook daily meals for the household to a consistently high standard.
  • Prepare dishes to suit the household's tastes and any dietary needs.
  • Plan weekly menus and portions, and suggest new dishes.
  • Keep the kitchen clean and follow food safety and hygiene standards.
  • Monitor kitchen stock, buy or request groceries and keep waste low.

Requirements

  • Certificate from a culinary school
  • At least 2 years' experience as a chef
  • Good communication skills
  • Presentable and able to work with little to no supervision
  • Able to work in Wuye and Wuse 2, Abuja and resume immediately
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Accommodation.
  • Weekly days off.

job.title: Sports Sales Manager
job.description:
We are hiring a Sports Sales Manager in Wuye, Abuja. This is a full-time role, and the salary of ₦250,000 per month is negotiable.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, source and manage the range of sports products sold online.
  • Create and update product listings with clear descriptions, photos and prices.
  • Track stock, sales and customer feedback, and recommend what to stock next.
  • Work with suppliers, the sales team and customer service to keep the store running smoothly.

Requirements

  • Experience in e-commerce, product management, and sales
  • A love for sports or sporting activities, with good knowledge of sports products
  • Good communication, organisation and analytical skills
  • Must be able to use Microsoft Word and Excel
  • Able to commute to Wuye, Abuja
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Other statutory benefits.

job.title: Customer Service
job.description:
We are hiring a Customer Service for a health and wellness business in Wuse 2, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role.

Responsibilities

  • Welcome and assist customers who walk into the store, and recommend suitable products.
  • Respond to customer enquiries and messages online (WhatsApp, social media and calls).
  • Record orders accurately and follow up so customers are satisfied.

  • Good communication skills, in person and in writing
  • Friendly, patient and presentable
  • Comfortable using a phone, WhatsApp and basic computer tools
  • Able to commute to Wuse 2, Abuja and resume immediately
  • CV Required (PDF)

Benefits

  • Other statutory benefits.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:

  • 5 to 8 Years' Experience in Accounting
  • Knowledge of Nigerian tax rules

job.title: Sales Assistant
job.description:
We are hiring a Sales Assistant for a clothing store in Wuse 2, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role for a presentable, confident communicator who is comfortable handling fabrics and can resume immediately.

  • Handle, fold and display fabrics and clothing with care, and keep the shop floor tidy.
  • Keep the store presentable and report stock and customer requests to the store management.

Requirements

  • 1-2 Years' Experience in Sales or Retail
  • Good communication skills
  • Presentable and comfortable handling fabrics
  • Able to commute to Wuse 2, Abuja and resume immediately
